noun_definition: Custom report name refers to a user-defined label that can be assigned to a report in the workspace settings, allowing users to customize the title of their expense reports.
Delete option refers to the functionality in the Title report field that allows a user to remove the custom report name but fails to perform the expected action of making the field disappear.
Title report field refers to the specific input area in the expense report where a custom name for the report can be entered and subsequently deleted.
